name: print-social-creativity-power-of-art-stories-purple-marble-bust
title: 'Creativity, The Power of Art' story set in magenta and navy with a tinted classical marble bust
whatItIs: Five vertical story cards in magenta and navy geometric blocks, each featuring a purple-tinted photo of a classical marble bust sculpture (sometimes with flowers on its head), bold condensed headlines ('Make Art', 'Be Creative', 'Artistic') and a pink 'Make Art' pill button.
whatItMeans: Artistic and bold; a tinted classical sculpture against flat geometric blocks bridges fine art history with modern graphic design.
techniques: Tint a classical sculpture photo in the brand's accent colour.
Split the frame into large flat geometric colour blocks.
Repeat one CTA pill across every card in a set.

vocabulary.definition: A classical sculpture depicting a head and shoulders.
A large flat shape used to structure a layout.
